name: ZeroShot 2000-lesson expansion
not_a_release_claim: IDs reserve authoring capacity. Counts are not evidence of distinct or runnable lessons. Each slot needs its own reviewed objective and full release gates.

modules.title: Matrix structure and numerical operators
modules.objective: Inspect matrix structure and exploit it to build or solve small linear models.
modules.worked_example_direction: Solve boundary-constrained readings on a three-node sensor graph.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m33-m35 and m148-m149 already cover bases, Cholesky, triangular solves, Jacobi and pivoting.

modules.title: Discrete counting with constraints
modules.objective: Count feasible assignments and weighted outcomes under finite restrictions.
modules.worked_example_direction: Count shift assignments with forbidden worker-task pairs.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m122 and m134-m139 cover hypergeometric counts, dice, combinations, inversions, grid routes, derangements and empty boxes.

modules.title: Measurement uncertainty and units
modules.objective: Carry uncertainty and support through measurement calculations.
modules.worked_example_direction: Combine correlated sensor errors into the uncertainty of one estimate.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m60 calibration, m61 masked means, m08 weighted moments and m130 total variance are existing lessons.

modules.title: Interval and fixed-point arithmetic
modules.objective: Compute conservative numerical bounds and explain representation error.
modules.worked_example_direction: Bound a ratio when both readings have finite instrument resolution.
modules.overlap_exclusions: No re-skinned clipping, scalar arithmetic drills or library-wrapper exercises.

modules.title: Compositional data and allocations
modules.objective: Reason about shares, constrained totals and comparisons.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare nutrient shares separately from total food quantity.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m65 conditional rows and m95 weight concentration are existing lessons.

modules.title: Circular and directional statistics
modules.objective: Summarize measurements whose endpoints wrap around.
modules.worked_example_direction: Summarize headings of 359 and 1 degrees correctly.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m106 polar coordinates is a prerequisite; changing angle units is not a new task.

modules.title: Survival and censoring
modules.objective: Build empirical survival summaries without treating censoring as failure.
modules.worked_example_direction: Track failures and right-censoring in an equipment cohort.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m132 absorbing probabilities uses a different model; do not repeat forward transition tasks.

modules.title: Time-series decomposition and dependence
modules.objective: Separate season, trend and residual dependence.
modules.worked_example_direction: Remove a weekly demand pattern and inspect residual lag dependence.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m72-m79 and m97-m99 cover basic smoothing, differences, interpolation, errors and rolling splits.

modules.title: Spectral representations
modules.objective: Translate finite signals between time and frequency viewpoints.
modules.worked_example_direction: Explain why a shifted sinusoid spreads across DFT bins.
modules.overlap_exclusions: Different frequencies or transform normalization conventions are not separate lessons.

modules.title: Constrained optimization
modules.objective: Implement constraint-aware updates and verify feasibility.
modules.worked_example_direction: Allocate a budget across nonnegative weights under quadratic cost.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m37 proximal sparsity and m158 ridge coordinate minimization already exist.

modules.title: Uncertainty from small samples
modules.objective: Compute uncertainty with explicit sampling assumptions.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare a paired bootstrap with one that breaks pairing.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m48-m50, m92 and m96 already cover basic resampling, paired differences, jackknife means and Wilson intervals.

modules.title: Causal estimands and adjustment
modules.objective: Compute effects in supplied identifiable toy designs.
modules.worked_example_direction: Adjust a treatment comparison for unequal baseline-risk composition.
modules.overlap_exclusions: State causal assumptions; arithmetic alone does not establish identification.

modules.title: Experimental design and randomization
modules.objective: Plan assignments that isolate comparisons.
modules.worked_example_direction: Balance treatments within blocks and compute an interaction contrast.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m17 stratified splits and e30 grouped splits are not new treatment-design lessons.

modules.title: Forecast reconciliation and scoring
modules.objective: Make related forecasts obey constraints and evaluate distributions.
modules.worked_example_direction: Reconcile regional forecasts to a national total.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m59 quantile training, m97-m98 errors and e37 coverage are existing prerequisites.

modules.title: Risk and tail decisions
modules.objective: Measure tails under explicit payoff models.
modules.worked_example_direction: Average the worst tenth of a discrete loss distribution with fractional tail mass.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m25 quantile interpolation alone is not a new risk lesson.

modules.title: Queueing and renewal models
modules.objective: Translate arrival and service assumptions into performance calculations.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare capacities using a finite-state queue and its blocking probability.
modules.overlap_exclusions: e149 and e151 already teach deterministic queue simulation and makespan.

modules.title: Stochastic process inference
modules.objective: Infer finite process dynamics from observed transitions.
modules.worked_example_direction: Estimate route transitions and calculate their stationary distribution.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m131-m132 forward transitions and survival are excluded.

modules.title: Graph probability and diffusion
modules.objective: Use graph structure to model flows and uncertainty.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare long-run visits with degrees and teleportation probabilities.
modules.overlap_exclusions: First math batch owns Laplacian construction and Dirichlet solves; existing graph neural layers are deep-learning operations.

modules.title: Three-dimensional geometry
modules.objective: Recover geometric relationships and coordinate changes.
modules.worked_example_direction: Project points into a pinhole camera and flag those behind it.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m100-m119 already cover planar geometry, axes and plane construction.

modules.title: Spatial statistics and interpolation
modules.objective: Measure spatial dependence under explicit neighborhood models.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare spatial autocorrelation before and after trend removal.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m56 radial kernels and m79 linear interpolation remain prerequisites.

modules.title: Numerical calculus and differential models
modules.objective: Audit discretizations and numerical error behavior.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare Euler and midpoint errors under step refinement.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m140-m149 already cover elementary polynomial calculus, roots, Simpson and Euler cooling.

modules.title: Monte Carlo with supplied draws
modules.objective: Transform fixed randomness and diagnose estimator efficiency.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare a paired-uniform integral estimator with ordinary sampling.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m125 categorical inverse CDF and e51/e54 reservoir and weighted samples are excluded.

modules.title: Regression diagnostics and influence
modules.objective: Explain sensitivity and misspecification in fitted models.
modules.worked_example_direction: Find a low-residual observation whose removal changes the fit.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m151 simple-line fitting and m152 baseline comparison are existing lessons.

modules.title: Bayesian model checks
modules.objective: Update and compare Bayesian models with explicit priors.
modules.worked_example_direction: Update a finite parameter grid and predict a future noisy reading.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m20, m52 and m53 already teach Bayes rule and beta/category updates.

modules.title: Information and coding
modules.objective: Connect probability to compression and dependence.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare prefix-code expected length with entropy.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m21-m24 entropy and divergences are prerequisites, not new formula wrappers.

modules.title: Transport and matching
modules.objective: Recover cost-aware correspondences and mass movement.
modules.worked_example_direction: Move mass between bins while preserving both marginals.
modules.overlap_exclusions: m55 one-dimensional Wasserstein distance already exists; require plan recovery or new constraints.

modules.title: Decision analysis and reliability
modules.objective: Choose actions under uncertainty and reliability requirements.
modules.worked_example_direction: Determine whether an imperfect inspection changes a maintenance decision.
modules.overlap_exclusions: e39 expected classification cost and m120 event sets are existing lessons.

modules.title: Tensor layouts and indexing contracts
modules.objective: Transform tensors while preserving sample and feature meaning.
modules.worked_example_direction: Reassemble unequal sequence segments without mixing samples.
modules.overlap_exclusions: Existing patchification, subpixel shuffle, embedding gather and repeated-token scatter are excluded.

modules.title: Spatial operators and boundaries
modules.objective: Build spatial transformations with explicit boundary behavior.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare reflection and zero padding at an image edge.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d09-d11 and d37 already cover convolution, pooling shape and separable convolution.

modules.title: Spatial derivatives and reconstruction
modules.objective: Trace local contributions back through image operations.
modules.worked_example_direction: Scatter overlapping window gradients into their original pixels.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d52-d54 and d108/d112 cover basic pooling, convolution gradients, unfolding and unpooling.

modules.title: Normalization diagnostics and derivatives
modules.objective: Understand how normalization changes dependence and gradients.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare predictions when training batch composition changes.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d03/d18/d25/d55/d126 already cover forward normalization and folding.

modules.title: Embedding objectives and geometry
modules.objective: Construct representation objectives and diagnose collapse.
modules.worked_example_direction: Separate hard-negative selection from the contrastive gradient.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d27/d61/d62 already cover basic contrastive and triplet objectives.

modules.title: Variable-length sequence processing
modules.objective: Preserve sequence semantics through batching and state changes.
modules.worked_example_direction: Reset only the recurrent states of sequences that end.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d100-d104 and e10/e60 already cover next-token pairs and basic padding.

modules.title: Attention architecture and attribution
modules.objective: Inspect attention under different context and representation constraints.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare full context with compressed keys under the same mask.
modules.overlap_exclusions: Existing masked, local, kernel, grouped and differential attention and RoPE are prerequisites.

modules.title: Optimizer state and schedules
modules.objective: Implement optimizer state and constraint handling.
modules.worked_example_direction: Trace coordinate adaptation under sparse gradients.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d14/d15/d21/d83/d95-d98 already cover momentum, Adam, warmup, freezes and decay.

modules.title: Learning objectives and robust gradients
modules.objective: Derive losses with different statistical targets.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare squared and bounded-influence gradients on an outlier.
modules.overlap_exclusions: Cross entropy, focal, Huber, quantile and elementary contrastive objectives already exist.

modules.title: Calibration and uncertainty decomposition
modules.objective: Separate confidence, ambiguity and disagreement.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare ensembles with the same mean and different disagreement.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d88/d89/d125/d128 and e16/e17 cover margins, ensembles, distillation and temperature derivatives.

modules.title: Image augmentation contracts
modules.objective: Transform pixels and supervision in the same coordinates.
modules.worked_example_direction: Rotate image coordinates and carry bounding boxes with them.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d117-d120 already cover erase, CutMix, mixup and restoration.

modules.title: Detection and localization
modules.objective: Build geometry and matching inside detection training.
modules.worked_example_direction: Assign valid anchors while retaining unmatched objects.
modules.overlap_exclusions: e42/e43 basic IoU and suppression and d115/d116 heatmap location are excluded.

modules.title: Dense prediction objectives
modules.objective: Reason about dense labels and class imbalance.
modules.worked_example_direction: Score segmentation without counting ignored pixels as background.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d63 Dice and d114 region boundaries are existing lessons.

modules.title: Video and motion tensors
modules.objective: Preserve temporal geometry and evaluate motion.
modules.worked_example_direction: Warp a frame and mark out-of-bounds pixels.
modules.overlap_exclusions: Adding a time axis alone is not a distinct objective.

modules.title: Audio representations and reconstruction
modules.objective: Connect waveforms, spectral frames and model targets.
modules.worked_example_direction: Reconstruct a waveform and inspect window coverage.
modules.overlap_exclusions: Math spectral modules own transform theory; this module owns model-facing contracts and losses.

modules.title: Graph learning beyond neighborhood averages
modules.objective: Build graph operators under explicit structural assumptions.
modules.worked_example_direction: Correct aggregation with known neighbor inclusion probabilities.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d28-d30/d38/d40/d44/d45 already cover basic graph architectures.

modules.title: State-space and long-memory operators
modules.objective: Inspect recurrence, discretization and convolution equivalents.
modules.worked_example_direction: Check a chunked scan against sequential recurrence.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d46 and d107 cover diagonal memory and streaming convolution.

modules.title: Generative noise schedules and solvers
modules.objective: Relate parameterizations and numerical sampling steps.
modules.worked_example_direction: Convert epsilon prediction into velocity at one noise level.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d32-d34/d59 cover basic schedules, flows and reverse steps.

modules.title: Latent-variable objectives
modules.objective: Build bounds and structured latent calculations.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare an ELBO with an importance-weighted bound.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d57/d58/d122 cover Gaussian KL, reparameterization and VQ gradients.

modules.title: Reinforcement learning estimators
modules.objective: Construct estimators under episode and behavior-policy contracts.
modules.worked_example_direction: Correct an off-policy trajectory without crossing episode boundaries.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d70-d79 and m18 already cover common TD, GAE and clipped objectives.

modules.title: Model compression and efficiency
modules.objective: Quantify error while changing model representation.
modules.worked_example_direction: Prune under a budget and report output error and retained energy.
modules.overlap_exclusions: e18/e45, d20 and d123 already teach basic quantization, LoRA and spectral constraints.

modules.title: Automatic differentiation building blocks
modules.objective: Represent dependencies and differentiate compositions.
modules.worked_example_direction: Differentiate a solved system using an adjoint solve.
modules.overlap_exclusions: Existing local layer gradients are prerequisites; no supplied-derivative wrappers.

modules.title: Training dynamics and numerical failure
modules.objective: Diagnose training failures before curves hide them.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare microbatch gradient directions at the same aggregate loss.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d84-d99 already cover scales, saturation, clipping, conflicts and directional curvature.

modules.title: Continual and multi-task learning
modules.objective: Control interference across objectives and time.
modules.worked_example_direction: Measure backward transfer without confusing it with final average accuracy.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d93 conflict diagnosis alone is not a new learning operation.

modules.title: Interpretability and explanation checks
modules.objective: Construct explanations and test their limits.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare attribution totals with a baseline-to-input output change.
modules.overlap_exclusions: d90/d91 linear contributions and input gradients already exist.

modules.title: Relational records and reconciliation
modules.objective: Preserve multiplicity and missingness across record combinations.
modules.worked_example_direction: Join orders to fulfillments without duplicating totals.
modules.overlap_exclusions: e63-e102 cover basic record loops and grouping; do not rename them.

modules.title: Data contracts and schema evolution
modules.objective: Validate nested contract changes and report precise errors.
modules.worked_example_direction: Check an old reader against a changed producer schema.
modules.overlap_exclusions: e98/e129-e137 basic tabular checks are prerequisites.

modules.title: Unicode and text boundaries
modules.objective: Align text with bytes and normalized forms.
modules.worked_example_direction: Map normalized matches back to original text spans.
modules.overlap_exclusions: e103-e113 ASCII and UTF-8 basics are excluded.

modules.title: Tokenization and structured language data
modules.objective: Build deterministic preprocessing under ambiguity.
modules.worked_example_direction: Find minimum-cost segmentation in a finite vocabulary.
modules.overlap_exclusions: e11/e12 BPE merge and basic tokenizers already exist.

modules.title: Retrieval indexes and query execution
modules.objective: Test query semantics independently of ranking scores.
modules.worked_example_direction: Find gapped phrases while preserving document positions.
modules.overlap_exclusions: Existing TF-IDF, BM25, postings, fusion, MMR and top-k are prerequisites.

modules.title: Evidence assembly for grounded generation
modules.objective: Build traceable context and citations.
modules.worked_example_direction: Fit passages into context while retaining source spans.
modules.overlap_exclusions: e01/e13/e107 basic chunks and budgets need a new provenance or conflict objective.

modules.title: Evaluation datasets and diagnostic slices
modules.objective: Aggregate evaluations without denominator errors.
modules.worked_example_direction: Report subgroup performance and support, including empty slices.
modules.overlap_exclusions: Existing classification, ranking and agreement metrics cannot be repeated.

modules.title: Event-time stream processing
modules.objective: Reconcile out-of-order observations with explicit timing rules.
modules.worked_example_direction: Revise a window when a late event arrives before closure.
modules.overlap_exclusions: e101/e144/e145 already cover ordered merges, fixed windows and sessions.

modules.title: Cache consistency and incremental state
modules.objective: Represent freshness across dependent data.
modules.worked_example_direction: Invalidate entries whose declared source versions changed.
modules.overlap_exclusions: e58/e146/e160-e162 cover basic LRU, idempotency and rebuilds.

modules.title: Scheduling and dependency execution
modules.objective: Plan under resource, fairness and dependency constraints.
modules.worked_example_direction: Schedule a DAG under bounded memory and explain idle intervals.
modules.overlap_exclusions: e79/e80/e149-e153 basic scheduling is excluded.

modules.title: Admission control and resilient requests
modules.objective: Make overload and failure policies testable.
modules.worked_example_direction: Compare burst admission under a sliding time limit.
modules.overlap_exclusions: e59/e147/e148 token bucket, retries and circuit breaker already exist.

modules.title: Model and tensor interchange
modules.objective: Encode tensor dtype, order, alignment and integrity.
modules.worked_example_direction: Reassemble shards and detect swapped axes or missing byte ranges.
modules.overlap_exclusions: e157-e159 byte frames and digests need new tensor structure.

modules.title: Feature pipelines and lineage
modules.objective: Apply training transformations reproducibly to later data.
modules.worked_example_direction: Recover feature values actually available at prediction time.
modules.overlap_exclusions: e32/e62/e136 already cover imputation, as-of joins and categories.

modules.title: Experiment tracking and reproducibility
modules.objective: Make run comparisons and reruns trustworthy.
modules.worked_example_direction: Detect experiments with different data versions or splits.
modules.overlap_exclusions: No exercises that merely stringify metadata or print a seed.

modules.title: API contracts and batch inference
modules.objective: Align requests and responses under partial failures.
modules.worked_example_direction: Reorder asynchronous results while retaining per-item errors.
modules.overlap_exclusions: e81 and e116-e128 basic pagination and parsing are excluded.

modules.title: Privacy and input-boundary operations
modules.objective: Implement bounded defensive handling under stated assumptions.
modules.worked_example_direction: Redact data and report removed spans without logging secrets.
modules.overlap_exclusions: No production-security guarantee; e106/e126 basics are existing lessons.

modules.title: Serving resource and cost accounting
modules.objective: Calculate resource plans from requests and model dimensions.
modules.worked_example_direction: Choose a batch that fits memory and report padding overhead.
modules.overlap_exclusions: Existing KV, expert routing, gradient accumulation and packing lessons remain prerequisites.

release_gates: Distinct objective and nearest-existing-lesson comparison before authoring
Original work or verified compatible license and complete attribution
Three worked examples, two progressive hints, stepwise explanation and at least ten meaningful public cases
Independent oracles use a different algorithm, derivation, enumeration or invariants
Explicit bounds, dtypes, shapes, ties, empty-input behavior and no mutation
Schema and prerequisite graph, native reference checks, starter failure and canned-answer rejection
Pinned Pyodide evaluation and browser execution/isolation checks
Editorial review and beginner/path integration before exact-count promotion
Production build, desktop/mobile QA and final GitHub CI before release claims
